reactive_range.requirement: Reactive power range at the PoC
reactive_range.source: EU RfG (2016/631) and DCC (2016/1388), Continental Europe: DCC Art. 15(1)(a): not wider than 48 percent of the larger of the maximum import or export capacity (0,9 power factor); the relevant TSO specifies the actual range. Needed 0.48 × 40 MW import = 19.2 Mvar; offered 1.315 Mvar (rooftop_pv 1.31) as P × tan(acos rated power factor), an assumed capability at rated power from the units offering voltage control (a unit the island study does not credit counts zero)
